text: Roads: internal asphalt roads shall be designed for 40 t axle loads to the heaviest delivery route (ER-13.05). The heaviest delivery route shall additionally be checked for the heaviest transport unit of the power island from the quay (400 t quay crane, heavy-lift port 18 km by sea, DP-OWNR-0046); the state road is limited to 120 t gross (DP-OWNR-0045), so transformers, rotors and other loads above this limit shall be shipped by sea and moved on site with self-propelled modular transporters; the route on site shall be checked for the bearing capacity of the fill and of buried services (culverts, duct banks with concrete cover or steel plate).
